incidents.name: Akutars auction processRefunds() unbounded refund loop
incidents.lossOther: 11,539.5 ETH permanently locked in the auction contract
incidents.notes: processRefunds() refunded bidders in a single loop with a push transfer, and claimProjectFunds() required the refund cursor to reach the end, so one bidding contract that rejected ETH permanently blocked both functions and locked every bid in the contract.

sources.ref: onchain review: AkuAuction 0xF42c318dbfBaab0EEE040279C6a2588Fa01a961d created 2022-04-22T20:32:27Z by 0xcc0ecd808ce4fed81f0552b3889656b28aa2bae9 (the project owner), unrelated to the tx sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment - 15,262 seconds (4.2 hours) old when the auction closed. This is a griefing/denial-of-service bug with no attacker profit: 11,539.5 ETH x $2,960.64 at incidentTimestamp 1650674809 (DefiLlama) = $34,164,388 of bids frozen, not stolen.
